_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every headline number Cavitation displays or prints.
_rule: No number appears in README.md, SUBMISSION.md or on the rendered site unless it is in this file with a provenance entry. make.py reads this to build the payload's stats block; research/NUMBERS.md is the human-readable view of it.

cohort.label: cohort
cohort.scope: wallets clearing 4+ of the 75 winning tokens resolved in the 30 days to 2026-08-31, from a 5,399-trader pool. Small because one month is a short window to win four separate tokens in; the map's 741 is the same threshold over 141 days.

map_cohort.label: map cohort
map_cohort.scope: wallets clearing 4+ separate winning tokens out of 32,128 traders scanned over the 141-day window. This is what the map draws, not what the coverage figure is measured on. Distinct from the 739 wallets that appear in the 150-token cache — counting those is a different quantity and was the source of a drift bug.
map_cohort.source: data/cohort_v2_balances.json (one entry per cohort wallet, len() == 741)

oot.label: out-of-time coverage
oot.scope: Cohort frozen 2026-08-31 with zero post-freeze information and tested against the 9 Robinhood-chain winners that first emerged 1-20 September. Same 4+ recurrence threshold the map is built on; the frozen cohort is 15 wallets, drawn from a 5,399-trader pool over a 30-day training window. Naive across all four chains the same run scores 42% (10 of 24): base 2/3, bnb 1/6, solana 0/6 — coverage tracks the repeat-winner rate, which is the product's central finding.
oot.headline: 78% of the next month's Robinhood-chain winners were already on this map

lift.label: precision lift
lift.scope: Leave-one-out over the 48-day window: of 2,813 tokens the cohort touched, the 35 passing >=8 wallets AND >$250k peak contained 10 of the 35 winners. Measures conviction-weighted filtering, not prediction.

lead.label: median lead
lead.scope: Days from first cohort entry to price peak, across the 30 covered winners. Raw median 23d; 16d after removing 7 entries censored by the window start. 23/30 entered >=7 days before peak; 0/30 entered after it.

naive_oot.label: naive coverage
naive_oot.scope: The same frozen-cohort run counted across all four chains without scoping to the ecosystem where repeat winners exist. Stated so the 78% is never read as a cross-chain result.
